title: status
subtitle: live checks of my sites and cluster nodes. probed every minute; uptime covers however much history prometheus actually kept.
unavailable: metrics are unavailable right now, try again later.
source: measured by a blackbox exporter inside the cluster and stored in prometheus. this is server-side latency, not from your browser.
nodesNote: nodes are shown by city and hoster, without machine names. node ping is measured from inside the cluster, so the one closest to the prober reads near zero.
